description: Sharing to Baude from other apps on the phone: Bots as targets in the system share sheet, what a share puts in the chat, and the banner on the home screen that asks where to send a share sent to Baude itself.
opens: another app's Share, then a Bot (its picture or initials as the icon, most recently active first)
another app's Share, then Baude (plain): the home screen with the banner
a Bot's shortcut in the launcher's long-press menu opens its chat

parts.name: Bots as share targets
parts.shows: Each Bot (as many as the launcher takes, most recently active first) is a sharing shortcut: its name, its picture or its initials on its avatar's gradient as the icon. Sending a message to a Bot ranks it higher. A Bot that is gone (deleted, archived, made a chat again, or its host removed) has its shortcut taken away or disabled ("This Bot isn't there any more"); one whose host has not listed yet is kept.
text: This Bot isn't there any more

actions.by: pick a Bot in the share sheet
actions.does: opens that Bot's chat with the shared text put in the box (after what is already there) and the shared files attached, ready to send; back then returns to the app it was shared from

parts.name: What a share puts in the chat
parts.shows: The text (a link's too, else the subject if no file) goes in the message box, after what is there; each file is read and attached as the chat's own attachments. Nothing is sent: you send it.

parts.name: Share banner
parts.shows: A bar over the home screen while a share waits: "Choose a Bot or session to send this to" with a close button.
text: Choose a Bot or session to send this to

actions.does: the share is put in that chat and cleared
drops the share and returns to the app it was shared from

parts.name: Kept across a restart
parts.shows: A share not yet sent, the open chat's box text and attached files are kept if Android ends the app, and put back when it is made again.

states.name: share waiting
states.shows: The home screen has the banner

states.name: opened from Recents
states.shows: Not treated as a share again
